name: TCL 65Q650G
summary: TCL 65Q650G ships with TCL analytics, silent app installs and nags. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This US TCL runs Google TV on Android 11. It ships with TCL analytics, silent installs of partner apps, TCL account sign-in nags and an agreement screen. It also has TCL Live FAST channels, a TCL TV+ content app, a web video portal, a memory cleaner, Works with Alexa and an e-manual.

The list was applied in three batches on a real unit. Home, the remote's Input panel and Live TV with all four HDMI ports kept working. After a reboot every app stayed off. TidyTV saves a backup first and never deletes anything, so each app can be switched back on.
keep: Live TV and all four HDMI ports
The remote's Input button and mic
notes: Once the stock home is off, the remote's Netflix, YouTube and Prime Video buttons do nothing until key remaps are set up.
Check which service owns your saved Wi-Fi before turning off the setup app.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my TCL 65Q650G?
faq.a: Yes. The mic button keeps working with the stock home screen off.

faq.q: Will the remote's Netflix button still work?
faq.a: Not by default once the stock home is off. The remote's Netflix, YouTube and Prime Video buttons need key remaps.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on and puts the stock Google TV home screen back.
